turns.prompt:
CONTEXT: I run a two-person sourdough bakery in a college town. Most
customers are students and faculty who visit on weekends. Starting
March 3 we offer a weekday lunch special: soup and half a sandwich for
$9, 11 a.m. to 2 p.m.

ROLE: You are a local-business copywriter who writes short, warm social
posts that get people through the door.

ACTION: Write an Instagram caption announcing the lunch special.

FORMAT: Under 80 words. One line hook, two short lines of detail, one
line with the time and price. Up to three hashtags at the end.

TONE: Friendly and a little playful, like the person behind the counter
who knows your order. No exclamation marks.
turns.output:
You already know our weekend loaves.
Starting March 3, soup and half a sandwich on that same sourdough.
A proper lunch for between classes and office hours.
Weekdays 11 a.m. to 2 p.m., $9.
#sourdough #lunchspecial #collegetown
